entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand threat telemetry + kinetic headline left, interactive 3D particle canvas & live threat monitor right
entry_surfaces./report: tactical single-column incident intake cockpit — priority banner top, structured triage fields center, instant cryptographic case ID confirmation modal

visual_enhancers.grid_overlay: Subtle 40px cyber grid matrix (`bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,#1e293b18_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(to_bottom,#1e293b18_1px,transparent_1px)] bg-[size:4rem_4rem]`) with vignette mask
visual_enhancers.radar_animation: Conic scanner pulse on threat overview with radar sweep CSS animation
visual_enhancers.terminal_telemetry: Live status ticker with UTC ISO timestamps, latency ping indicator (24ms), and global threat severity status
visual_enhancers.editorial_ribbon: react-fast-marquee powered low-drift banner with security standard acronyms (NIST CSF 2.0 • ISO/IEC 27001 • ZERO TRUST ARCHITECTURE • MITRE ATT&CK • GDPR DPO READY • OWASP TOP 10)

layouts_and_grids.navbar: Fixed header (z-50) with glassmorphism `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#070a0f]/85 border-b border-slate-800/80`. Contains Logo, Navigation items (Threats, Safety Tips, Intelligence/Stats, Live Radar), Incident Report CTA with emergency pulsing beacon (`/report`), and status ping indicator.
layouts_and_grids.hero_section: Two-column bento asymmetric layout (lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8). Col-span-7 holds line-by-line masked kinetic heading, mission narrative, primary CTA ('Report Active Incident' & 'Explore Threat Matrix') and quick diagnostic stats. Col-span-5 holds interactive Threat Simulation Card with live radar toggle & defense health score.
layouts_and_grids.editorial_marquee: Full-width seamless ticker ribbon featuring dark slate background (#0a0f18) and emerald telemetry tags.
layouts_and_grids.threats_overview_bento: Asymmetric 4-card high-impact grid: Phishing (Col-span-12 lg:col-span-7 with interactive email analyzer simulation), Ransomware (Col-span-12 lg:col-span-5 with encryption countdown preview), Social Engineering (Col-span-12 lg:col-span-5 with conversational trap breakdown), Malware & Zero-Days (Col-span-12 lg:col-span-7 with live payload sandbox inspector).
layouts_and_grids.safety_tips_interactive: Interactive 4-tier tactical defense matrix with tabbed drill-down (Identity & MFA, Device Hardening, Network Hygiene, Crisis Runbook) featuring actionable checklist cards with copy-ready guidance.
layouts_and_grids.statistics_dashboard: High-density cyber metric bento with recharts visualization: Global Attack Volume by Vector, Average Breach Cost breakdown ($4.45M), Mean Time to Detect (MTTD vs MTTR gauge), and 2026 Emerging Threat Forecast.
layouts_and_grids.incident_report_page: Dedicated `/report` route. Single-column focused intake form: Step 1 (Incident Category: Phishing, Ransomware, Unauthorized Access, Data Leak, DDoS, Malware), Step 2 (Severity Rating: Low, Medium, High, Critical P1), Step 3 (Detailed Evidence & Target System), Step 4 (Reporter Details & Encrypted Confirmation). On submit -> saves report to MongoDB backend via `/api/reports`, provides instant Case Reference ID (e.g. `CASE-2026-X94B`), instructions on immediate triage containment, and recent incident logs viewer.

motion_specs.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll integration on root layout
motion_specs.radar_pulse: repeating radar sweep keyframe with 4s loop

endpoints.desc: Saves incident report, generates unique CASE-2026-XXXX reference ID and returns confirmation
Returns recent public sanitized incident radar logs with triage status
Returns live intelligence summary metrics (total reported, active triage, resolved, vector distribution)

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `lenis` or `@studio-freight/lenis` / `lenis/react` if needed, and `react-fast-marquee` (`yarn add react-fast-marquee lenis`). Note that `@fontsource-variable/outfit`, `@fontsource-variable/dm-sans`, and `@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono` are already available in the container - just import them in `frontend/src/index.css`.
Ensure `frontend/index.html` has `<html class='dark'>` and title 'AEGIS // Threat Radar & Incident Response Grid'.

Build the two required views: `frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx` (Awareness landing page with kinetic hero, threats bento, safety tips matrix, statistics charts with recharts) and `frontend/src/pages/ReportIncident.tsx` (Tactical incident response intake form with live validation and confirmation modal).
In `backend/server.py` or `backend/routers/reports.py`, implement FastAPI routes for POST `/api/reports` and GET `/api/reports` and GET `/api/stats`, backing to MongoDB `incident_reports` collection.

Seed `backend/seed.py` with 8 realistic initial threat reports (e.g. Spear Phishing Executive impersonation, LockBit 4.0 ransomware attempt, API credential leak) so the intelligence radar displays live telemetry out of the box.
Use high-contrast slate (#070A0F) with emerald (#10B981) and cyan accents. Never use generic full-screen gradients. Keep text APCA accessible.
Make sure all interactive and key informational elements have their specified `data-testid` attributes.
